data.name: Balitay
data.gender_notes: Balitay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balitay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bal' meaning strong and 'itay' meaning like a lion. This name signifies strength and courage, evoking the image of a fearless and powerful lion. The name Balitay carries the meaning “Strong as a Lion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balitay usually hope their child will grow to embody strong as a lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Balitay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong as a Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balitay total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
